samples.summary: `stepSelectionFontSize` silently widened to table-cell text for cross-block selections
samples.evidence: The removed walk read `doc.getContextBlocks()[i].inlines` for each block in the range; a `table` block has no inlines, so text inside tables was never collected. `visitStyledRunsInRange` → `visitRangeSlices` covers a table caught in a cross-block selection *whole* (range-slices.ts, the `block.type === 'table'` branch). Consumers outside the diff: `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:367` (`handleFontSizeStepMixed` → `stepSelectionFontSize`) now resizes every cell of any table the selection crosses, and `packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/use-resolved-font-size.ts:31` / `use-resolved-font-family.ts:31` will now report `'mixed'` (blank picker) for selections that cross a table where they previously reported the body value. This may well be the intended alignment with `applyInlineStyle`'s write, but it is a user-visible change to two toolbar controls that the diff does not mention.

samples.summary: Slim header/footer B/I/U buttons remain uncontrolled `Toggle`s, so their pressed state still does not follow the range the handlers now read
samples.evidence: The handlers at docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:391-406 were switched to `isStyleOn(editor.getRangeStyleSummary()…)`, but the three `Toggle`s at lines 449, 458 and 467 pass no `pressed` prop at all — Radix keeps its own internal pressed state, which flips on every click regardless of the document. The shared `TextFormatGroup` was given `pressed={isStyleOn(styleSummary?.bold)}` in the same change; the slim toolbar was not, so the two surfaces now disagree about what the button shows (e.g. after applying bold to an already-bold range the slim button appears pressed even though the write removed bold). `slimSelectionStyle` at line 422 also remains caret-derived, which is fine for the color swatches but is now the only caret read left on this surface.

samples.summary: Slides text surfaces now read docs' built-in named-style defaults through `getSelectionStyle`/`getRangeStyleSummary`
samples.evidence: `caretStyle(true)` (text-box-editor.ts:847) and `visitStyledRunsInRange` (range-runs.ts:57) layer `resolveStyleInline(blockStyleId(block), doc.document.styles)` under every run. `initializeTextBox` backs the slides shape / text-box / table-cell editors (`packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:598-602`), whose documents carry no `styles` registry, so the *docs* built-ins in `named-styles.ts:82-92` now apply: a slides block typed `title` reports `fontSize: 26`, `subtitle`/`heading-3..6` report `color: '#666666'`/`'#434343'`, `heading-6` reports `italic: true`. Downstream consumers that never saw those values before: the text/highlight swatches at text-format-group.tsx:239 and :269, and the size/family pickers via `use-resolved-font-size.ts`/`use-resolved-font-family.ts`. I could not refute this being correct — slides paints through the same `computeLayout`/`resolveBlockInlines` cascade (`packages/slides/src/view/canvas/text-renderer.ts:237`), so the read matches the paint — but it is a cross-package read-surface change worth a second look for themed slide placeholders whose colors come from the slide-element layer rather than from the run.

samples.summary: `applyStyleImpl` still resolves cell parentage from the body-only `layout.blockParentMap` while the reads/writes it feeds now use the merged `doc.blockParentMap`
samples.evidence: The change deliberately moved the summary and the shared traversal onto `doc.blockParentMap` (merged body + header + footer, built at editor.ts:1312-1319) because `layout.blockParentMap` cannot resolve header/footer cells. The dirty-marking block immediately after the write (editor.ts:1053-1070) still consults `layout.blockParentMap`, so for a header/footer table-cell selection — which the toolbar can now newly reach a *removal* verdict for — neither `anchorCI`/`focusCI` nor `getBlockIndex` resolves and no block is marked dirty. I believe this degrades to a full repaint (`markDirty` treats `dirtyBlockIds === undefined` as 'repaint everything', editor.ts:1322-1327) rather than a stale frame, which is why I am filing it low-confidence/minor; the two parentage sources in one function are nonetheless now inconsistent and the cell-rectangle branch at line 1045 marks a header table id into a set the body pass will not match.

mergedFrom.summary: Text-box `stepSelectionFontSize` still reads raw `inline.style.fontSize`, now inconsistent with the summary that drives the picker

finding.summary: Text-box collapsed-caret summary path still returns raw run style, so the #715 keyboard/toolbar disagreement survives for carets in styled blocks
finding.evidence: The change makes `TextEditor.toggleStyle` decide from `styleDefaultsAtCursor()` + visual style for a collapsed caret (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2898/3006), and makes the range branch of the text-box summary effective-style aware. The collapsed branch of the text-box summary was not updated: packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1035 returns `{ ...inline.style, ...staged }` with no `resolveStyleInline` layer (compare the docs editor, which does layer defaults at editor.ts:2712-2722). Consequence in a slides/docs text box whose block's named style supplies italic: the toolbar's Italic toggle reads `undefined` → applies `italic: true` → pending style with no visual change (a permanent no-op, the exact #715 shape), while Cmd+I on the same caret now correctly writes `italic: false`. The toolbar `pressed` state also disagrees with the keyboard for the same caret.

verdict.reason: The code is not as described. The collapsed-caret branch of the text-box style summary (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1011-1014) returns `{ ...caretStyle(true), ...staged }`, not `{ ...inline.style, ...staged }`. `caretStyle(true)` (text-box-editor.ts:847-863) layers the block's named-style inline defaults via `resolveStyleInline(blockStyleId(block), doc.document.styles)` (line 851) under the run style (lines 857, 862), imported at line 38 — exactly the `resolveStyleInline` layer the finding says is missing. `getSelectionStyle` (lines 990-997) uses the same effective read, so the toolbar's caret read and pressed state match the keyboard's effective-style verdict. Line 1035, the cited location, is inside the `tokenize` helper of the range branch, not a return of raw inline style. There is no other implementation carrying the described raw path: the only other `getRangeStyleSummary` bodies are the full docs editor (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2680, which the finding treats as correct) and packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:601-603, which delegates straight through to the docs text-box API. The #715 disagreement the finding describes therefore cannot occur on this path.
